text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: That was fast. Did you catch the runaway student?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Yes. I gave her a piece of my mind as well. Poor observance of the dress code leads to poor discipline, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Strict as ever, I see. I noticed she seemed to be in pretty good shape…

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I expect it was quite a challenge chasing her down. Good thing you're persistent.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: There's a trick to catching up to a rival who has a head start. I was training for just such a situation the other day.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah? You must be feeling grateful to your trainer then.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You fool. It's a trainer's job to provide guidance. Why would I praise them just for doing their expected duties?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: If I were to tell my trainer anything, it would be the difficulties I experienced in order for us to revise those aspects and further improve my technique.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: And even if I did praise my trainer, I wouldn't want to encourage complacency.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: My, my, Empress. You really have taken a shine to your trainer.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Nothing of the sort! All I ask of my trainer is the bare minimum.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Oh, look—that student's shirt is untucked. Are you going to let that slide?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Of course not! You stay right there, and we'll finish this conversation when I get back!
